mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.merchant_id, (SELECT m.merchant_name FROM takeout_merchant m WHERE m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND m.del_flag = '0') AS merchant_name, o.total_amount, o.delivery_fee, o.discount_amount, o.actual_amount, o.coupon_user_id, o.status, o.pay_status, o.pay_method, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.address, o.remark, o.delivery_time, o.pay_time, o.complete_time, o.cancel_reason, o.del_flag, o.kitchen_id, o.kitchen_accept_time, o.ready_time, o.rider_id, o.rider_accept_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time FROM takeout_order o
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, order_id, dish_id, dish_name, dish_image, price, quantity, subtotal FROM takeout_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY item_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO takeout_order ( order_no, user_id, merchant_id, total_amount, delivery_fee, discount_amount, actual_amount, coupon_user_id, status, pay_status, pay_method, receiver_name, receiver_phone, address, remark, delivery_time, pay_time, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{totalAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{couponUserId}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{payMethod}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{address}, #{remark}, #{deliveryTime}, #{payTime}, #{createBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO takeout_order_item (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, dish_image, price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES
(#{it.orderId}, #{it.dishId}, #{it.dishName}, #{it.dishImage}, #{it.price}, #{it.quantity}, #{it.subtotal})
mapper.update:
UPDATE takeout_order
status = #{status}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, address = #{address}, remark = #{remark}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, delivery_fee = #{deliveryFee}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, actual_amount = #{actualAmount}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE takeout_order
status = #{status}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, kitchen_accept_time = #{kitchenAcceptTime}, ready_time = #{readyTime}, rider_accept_time = #{riderAcceptTime}, kitchen_id = #{kitchenId}, rider_id = #{riderId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE takeout_order
status = #{status}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM takeout_order_item ti JOIN takeout_order o ON o.order_id = ti.order_id WHERE ti.dish_id = #{dishId} AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status NOT IN ('5','6','7')

SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.merchant_id, (SELECT m.merchant_name FROM takeout_merchant m WHERE m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND m.del_flag = '0') AS merchant_name, o.total_amount, o.delivery_fee, o.discount_amount, o.actual_amount, o.coupon_user_id, o.status, o.pay_status, o.pay_method, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.address, o.remark, o.delivery_time, o.pay_time, o.complete_time, o.cancel_reason, o.del_flag, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time FROM takeout_order o JOIN takeout_order_item ti ON ti.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND ti.dish_id = #{dishId} ORDER BY o.order_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('0','1','2','3')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_dish WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}) AS dishCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND del_flag = '0') AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takeout_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM takeout_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('4','5','6') AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS totalAmount30d, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM takeout_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('4','5','6') AND DATE(pay_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayAmount
WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status = '2b' ORDER BY o.ready_time ASC, o.order_id ASC
WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status IN ('1', '2', '2a') ORDER BY CASE o.status WHEN '2a' THEN 1 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 END, o.pay_time ASC, o.order_id ASC
WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.status = '2b' FOR UPDATE

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS makingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2b' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS readyCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM takeout_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('1', '2', '2a', '2b')
